subject: 🎓 Graduation Day — Save the Date for $ceremony_date
body:
Dear $student_name,

You have officially completed the requirements for your award and your name has been entered onto the graduation list. Congratulations on this huge achievement!

This email is your invitation to the graduation ceremony — full ceremony, robing, ticket and post-event information is below.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
CEREMONY DETAILS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Student ID:        $student_id
Award:             $award
Programme:         $program_name
Ceremony Date:     $ceremony_date
Ceremony Time:     $ceremony_time
Venue:             $venue
Robing Required:   $robing_required
Robing Window:     $robing_window
Guest Tickets:     $guest_tickets_allowed (book by $rsvp_by)

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

NEXT STEPS

  1. Confirm your attendance via the Graduation Portal by $rsvp_by.
  2. Order your gown — without one you cannot cross the stage.
  3. Book your guest tickets at the same time as your RSVP.
  4. Plan your travel and accommodation; venues near campus book out quickly.
  5. Let us know about any accessibility needs or special arrangements.

CAN'T MAKE IT?

  • You can graduate in absentia — your award is still conferred and a parchment is posted to you.
  • A graduation refund/transfer to a later ceremony may be possible; contact the Graduation Office.

We are immensely proud of you and look forward to celebrating your achievement.

With warmest congratulations,
The Graduation Office
